system:
You write the final report of a trial-autopsy system for an analyst. Plain language, precise,
no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

Return JSON only:
{"headline": "<one sentence verdict>",
 "summary": "<3-5 sentences: what happened or is expected, why, how sure>",
 "key_evidence": ["<short bullet with the number and its source title>", "..."],
 "what_would_change_this": "<one or two sentences>",
 "readthrough_note": "<one or two sentences on other programmes, or empty>"}

response:
{
  "headline": "The STRENGTH trial of omega-3-carboxylic acids (Epanova) 4 g/day versus corn oil placebo was stopped early for futility, and no placebo-adjusted triglyceride change was measured to enable causal effect estimation.",
  "summary": "STRENGTH randomized approximately 13,078–13,086 statin-treated patients with hypertriglyceridemia (TG 175–499 mg/dL) and low HDL to Epanova 4 g/day or corn oil placebo, targeting 1,600 MACE events over a planned 3–5 year follow-up (median 3 years per design). The independent data monitoring committee recommended discontinuation in January 2020 because Epanova was unlikely to demonstrate benefit. The causal calculator returned 'not_computable' with category 'insufficient_data' because no placebo-adjusted triglyceride reduction was measured in the STRENGTH population: phase 2 data showed only a within-arm −26% TG change (not placebo-adjusted), and phase 3 biomarker data at 3 g/day were not reported. The minimum detectable hazard ratio at 80% power was 0.869. Confidence is high that the fundamental limitation is the absence of a measured, placebo-adjusted biomarker effect.",
  "key_evidence": [
    "~13,078 patients randomized (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT02104817 STRENGTH); 13,086 patients (Assessment of omega-3 carboxylic acids in statin-treated patients with high levels of triglycerides and low levels of high-density lipoprotein cholesterol: Rationale and design of the STRENGTH trial.); 13,086 patients (Update on Phase III STRENGTH trial for Epanova in mixed dyslipidaemia)",
    "Planned 1,600 MACE events; median follow-up 3 years (Assessment of omega-3 carboxylic acids in statin-treated patients with high levels of triglycerides and low levels of high-density lipoprotein cholesterol: Rationale and design of the STRENGTH trial.)",
    "Primary endpoint: time to first event of cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, stroke, coronary revascularization or hospitalization for unstable angina (Assessment of omega-3 carboxylic acids in statin-treated patients with high levels of triglycerides and low levels of high-density lipoprotein cholesterol: Rationale and design of the STRENGTH trial.)",
    "Corn oil placebo used (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT02104817 STRENGTH)",
    "Phase 2 triglyceride change: −26% within-arm only, explicitly not placebo-adjusted (Effects of free omega-3 carboxylic acids and fenofibrate on liver fat content in patients with hypertriglyceridemia and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease: A double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled study.)",
    "Phase 3 biomarker change at 3 g/day, 90 days: None not stated (Impairment of lysophospholipid metabolism in obesity: altered plasma profile and desensitization to the modulatory properties of n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids in a randomized controlled trial.)",
    "Calculator outcome: not_computable, category insufficient_data, weakest_link 'triglycerides change not measured'; MDE HR at 80% power = 0.869; notes: 'no measured change in triglycerides or another sized lipid: the effect is unknown, not zero'",
    "Trial stopped early for futility (Update on Phase III STRENGTH trial for Epanova in mixed dyslipidaemia)",
    "IDMC statement: 'Epanova is unlikely to demonstrate a benefit to patients' (Update on Phase III STRENGTH trial for Epanova in mixed dyslipidaemia)"
  ],
  "what_would_change_this": "A placebo-adjusted triglyceride change from STRENGTH or a phase 2 trial with proper placebo control at the 4 g/day dose would enable causal effect estimation; the full event count and hazard ratio at stopping would clarify whether a real effect was below the detection threshold.",
  "readthrough_note": "The corn oil placebo (vs mineral oil in REDUCE-IT) and uncertain triglyceride causality limit read-through to other omega-3 or triglyceride-lowering programmes; future trials need placebo-adjusted biomarker data and careful placebo selection to isolate drug effects."
}
